---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea for PassPaper
title: "[feat] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

**Problem**
What problem are you trying to solve? Who experiences it? (e.g. "I want my
handwritten derivation to survive a laptop reboot so I can pick up where I left
off in a git repo.")

**Proposed solution**
What you'd like PassPaper to do.

**Alternatives considered**
Any other approaches you thought about.

**Relationship to the moat**
PassPaper deliberately stays narrow: real-time, stable, private tablet
handwriting → local AI agents, plus replayable sessions and local CJK/formula
recognition. If your idea fits that scope, say how; if it's a broader "AI
whiteboard", note that we intentionally don't compete there.

**Additional context**
Links, mockups, references.
